meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Ultra-compressed code review comments. Cuts noise from PR feedback while preserving the actionable signal. Each comment is one line: location, problem, fix. Use when user says "review this PR", "code review", "review the diff", "/review", or invokes /caveman-review. Auto-triggers when reviewing pull requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长的代码审查压缩成一行精准反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果受够了又长又水的代码审查意见
copy.tagline_en: Compress code review feedback into one-line actionable comments
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of verbose and noisy code review comments

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 做代码审查时只输出极简评论:每条一行,格式为「行号:问题。修复。」并用🔴/🟡/🔵/❓ 前缀标出严重程度或疑问。遇到安全漏洞、架构分歧等特殊情况才写完整段落。
howto.when: 当你说『review this PR』等审查短语,或调用 /review、/caveman-review,或开始审查 PR 时自动触发。

say.text: 用 caveman-review 审查这个 PR,评论要一行一条。
say.note: 输出极简评论,含行号、问题、修复。

say.text: 把 L42 那条评论改成一行格式。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude gives terse one-line review comments: location, problem, fix. Optional severity prefixes: 🔴 bug, 🟡 risk, 🔵 nit, ❓ q. Uses file:Lline for multi-file diffs. Detailed paragraphs only for security, architectural, or newcomer cases.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "review this PR" (or similar review phrases), invoke /review or /caveman-review, or start reviewing a pull request.

say_en.text: Review this PR using caveman-review; keep comments to one line each.
say_en.note: Outputs terse comments with location, problem, fix.

say_en.text: Turn my L42 comment into the one-line format.
Comment in Chinese with a 🔴 bug prefix.
